hp_and_damage: integer; round half up after complete effect product; floor damage at 1 after reductions
coordinates: positive arena values; squared integer distance; no float trig in gameplay; checked-in integer lookup for heading, boomerang path and spawn angular proposals
rng: specified xorshift32 with nonzero seed, unsigned 32-bit operations; stream names spawn, loot, upgrade; derive from session seed with fixed recorded salts; publish vectors before implementation

input.movement: two signed int8 axes; magnitude <=127, quantized controller axis; deterministic normalization via integer lookup
input.pause: explicit reason and tick; not an extra free movement input

ties: hero death takes priority over boss death; objective deadline check after that tick interaction; final tick accepts kill if hero alive before timeout failure
collision: circle-circle/segment-circle with integer arithmetic and stable entity order; no authoritative Phaser Arcade collision callbacks
overflow: apply tuning caps in shared simulation; rejected batch still advances schedule/PRNG with no backlog
rendering: Phaser visuals project shared state. Arcade acceptable isolated research/prototype only; renderer collision is not server proof

input_log_limit.exceed_behavior: close invalid session with explanation; never silently truncate

replay_validation: headless same shared simulator seeded from server snapshot; compare objective, boss, HP, elapsed tick, upgrade legality, input count and checkpoints; client result never authoritative
CPU_gate: full 480s replay and chunk/checkpoint verification benchmark required on selected Cloudflare Worker plan; synchronous 14400-tick replay must not be assumed to fit CPU limits
verification_fallback: split deterministic replay via Queue jobs/checkpoints, provisional result until complete; do not replace proof with client score trust
server_clock: rate-limit impossible combat-time claims and concurrent sessions; pause durations allowed but do not advance combat
security_scope: separate mode endpoint; main BattleSubmission max600 turn actions cannot encode realtime log; no main combat currency/drops/tasks hook
integer_arithmetic: positions squared within Number safe range; segment/dot-product cross-products must use BigInt or checked equivalent; never unsafe JS multiplication beyond 2^53-1
movement_normalization: axes limited [-127,127]; if squared magnitude >127^2 use ceil_sqrt and integer rescale toward zero to radius<=127; speed/30 per tick, integer remainder carried by actor

rng_exact.algorithm: xorshift32: x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 17; x ^= x << 5; return x >>> 0
rng_exact.stream_initial: seed XOR salt, replace zero with 0x6d2b79f5
rng_exact.shuffle: Fisher-Yates descending i=len-1..1; j=nextUint32() % (i+1); fixed algorithm/version, slight modulo bias accepted for nonmonetized draft

cooldown_rule: floor(base_ticks*(1-slot_tempo_percent/100)*(1-capped_support_tempo_sum/100)); min12; cast cooldown advances even if pool rejects cast
reach_rule: base shape dimensions*(1+slot_reach_percent/100)*(1+capped_support_wide_cast_sum/100); quantize position dimensions round half up; no pierce scaling
damage_source_rule: one target hit per cast/hazard activation except boomerang at most once on outgoing and once on return; global hero iframe still applies; expiry of iframe never permits same static hazard activation to hit again
deadline_order_clarification: process all damage first; if alive accept same-tick boss death before timeout; objective completion at exact10800 is allowed, then boss transition; otherwise loss
boss_shapes: anchor at boss position when warning starts unless fixed arena-axis attack; relative axis line locks then; attack shape is final damage shape; phase change cancels old attacks without damage
safe_area_check: shared deterministic reachability approximation or exact test required; boss shapes use same safe-disk check as ambient; no warning may be dropped by cosmetic budget
progress_migration: new ranks append stable cell IDs after60; existing highest preserved. Numerical retuning forks simulation_revision, keeps best records separate.
phase_presentation_pause: 30 ticks-equivalent (1 second presentation) freezes combat tick; renderer/controller countdown then acknowledged resume input. Never count down a paused simulation timer.
boss_source_ids: each distinct lunge or damaging pulse receives stable attack activation ID; repeated overlap in one activation cannot deal more damage
